working_definition: Author cell type 'Poxn neuron' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult head, 102 cells): a marker-named group of head neurons (Poxn expression) with no author FBbt term (Manual Annotation).
justification: FBbt has no Poxn-expressing neuron class; searches only return unrelated lexical hits. The only available terms are generic (neuron / adult neuron), which would be a forced generic fallback, so the cluster is held.

other_candidates.reason_rejected: Too generic; generic fallback not allowed.

recommendation: Hold: no FBbt term for Poxn neuron. Flag only; no term request without curator sign-off.
